league: Cedar Park Youth League · 8U Coach Pitch

weeks.title: Coaching Plan — Greg + the Boys (ages 7 & 5)
weeks.note: Plan dated Oct 11, 2026; shown as the week of Mon Oct 5 for the calendar.

drills.name: Animal Walks
steps: Bear crawl like a strong bear.
Frog jump like a frog.
Crab walk with tummy up.
Flamingo stand on one foot!
drills.fun: Dad does the animal walks too. Race him!
drills.level_up: Can you bear crawl backward?

drills.name: Running Form — Cheek to Cheek
steps: Sit down and pump your arms: cheek to cheek!
Stand up and march — opposite arm, opposite knee.
Jog with those arms pumping.
Race a short sprint!
drills.fun: Race Dad's rolling ball to a cone. Or copy Dad's silly run, then "fast style!"
drills.level_up: Lean like you're about to fall — then GO!

videos.title: Running Technique for Kids | Core Kids

drills.name: Throwing Intro — Point, Step, Throw
steps: Stand sideways. Point your glove at the target.
Show the ball to the fence behind you.
Step with your front foot and throw!
Finish with your hand by your other pocket.
drills.fun: Knock Down the Castle! Stack cups and smash them with throws.
drills.level_up: Hit Dad's glove (or the target) 3 times in a row!

videos.title: Basic Throwing Mechanics | Baseball Drills
Baseball Throwing | Basic Techniques

drills.name: Freeze Tag with Flamingos
steps: Play freeze tag in the yard.
If you get tagged, freeze on ONE foot like a flamingo!
A high five from a friend unfreezes you.
Keep balancing until you're free!
drills.fun: Biggest flamingo wins a cheer!
drills.level_up: Freeze on one foot for a whole 5-count.

drills.name: Body Part Simon Says with a Ball
steps: Dribble the soccer ball with soft touches.
Dad calls a body part — stop the ball with that part!
Only move when Dad says Simon Says.
Keep the ball close the whole time.
drills.fun: Simon Says gets faster and sillier!
drills.level_up: Stop the ball with 3 different body parts in a row.

videos.title: U6 Body Part Dribble Activity

drills.name: Dribbling — Small Touches
steps: Tap the ball with the inside of your foot — soft!
Keep the ball on a leash (close to you).
Walk then jog while dribbling.
Try both feet!
drills.fun: Red light / green light while you dribble!
drills.level_up: Dribble around 3 cones without losing the ball.

videos.title: U6 Red Light/Green Light Activity

drills.name: Balance Challenges
steps: Stand on one foot like a flamingo.
Be a statue — tummy tight!
Try the other foot.
Can you balance while Dad makes funny faces?
drills.fun: Flamingo Contest! Who balances longest while Dad tries to make you laugh?
drills.level_up: Balance for 10 seconds with your eyes closed!

drills.name: Sharks and Minnows
steps: You are a minnow with a soccer ball.
Dribble across without the shark stealing it!
If your ball gets stolen, you become a shark.
Last minnow wins!
drills.fun: Dad is the big scary shark — swim fast!
drills.level_up: Cross the ocean 3 times without getting caught.

drills.name: Kid's Choice Play
steps: Pick a favorite game from this week.
No new lessons — just play!
Invite Dad to play too.
Stop while it is still fun.
drills.fun: You are the coach today. You pick the game!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad a new rule for your game.

drills.name: Balloon or Beach Ball Keep-Up
steps: Keep a balloon or beach ball up in the air.
Use your hands — eyes on it!
Don't let it touch the ground.
Count how many taps you get!
drills.fun: Team keep-up with Dad — beat your record!
drills.level_up: Get 10 taps in a row!

drills.name: Catching — Eyes on It, Fingers Up
steps: Eyes on the ball the whole way.
Fingers up for high balls (alligator for low).
Soft hands — squeeze when it lands.
Start close, then step back after each catch.
drills.fun: Catch Ladder! Every catch = one step back.
drills.level_up: Get 3 steps farther than where you started!

videos.title: How to Teach Baseball Catching to 5–7 Year Olds

drills.name: Tee Hitting — Squish the Bug
steps: Feet wider than shoulders beside the tee.
Eyes on the ball.
Swing and squish the bug with your back foot!
Watch where the ball flies.
drills.fun: Home Run Derby! Farther cones = more points.
drills.level_up: Hit 3 balls past the middle cone!

videos.title: Little League Tee Ball Newspaper Toss

drills.name: Run the Bases
steps: Start at home plate.
Run through first — don't stop on it!
Touch every base.
Slide into home with a big cheer!
drills.fun: Race the bases against Dad's timer!
drills.level_up: Run all the way around without slowing at first.

drills.name: Tail Tag
steps: Tuck a flag or sock in your waistband.
Try to pull Dad's flag without losing yours!
Keep your feet moving.
When your flag is pulled, you're it!
drills.fun: Everyone is a sneaky flag ninja!
drills.level_up: Pull Dad's flag 3 times before he gets yours.

drills.name: Flag Pulling — Break Down, Grab, Rip
steps: Eyes on the belt — not the face!
Chop your feet to slow down.
Grab the flag and RIP it out!
Hold it up like a trophy.
drills.fun: Flag Collector! Dad wears lots of flags — steal them all!
drills.level_up: Pull 4 flags in 30 seconds!

videos.title: Flag Pulling Drills | NFL FLAG Football

drills.name: Running with the Ball + Simple Catch
steps: Tuck the ball high and tight — hide it!
Run to a cone without dropping it.
For a catch: make diamond hands!
Squeeze the ball to your chest.
drills.fun: Touchdown dance every time you score!
drills.level_up: Run 15 steps without the ball wiggling out.

drills.name: Mini Game
steps: Play a tiny flag football game.
One team runs, one team pulls flags.
Score by crossing the end zone!
Switch sides and play again.
drills.fun: Make up a team name and a touchdown dance!
drills.level_up: Score 2 touchdowns in one game!

drills.name: Flamingo Stand
steps: Stand on one foot like a flamingo.
Hold as long as you can.
Switch feet and try again.
drills.fun: Be a statue — no wobbles!
drills.level_up: Beat your Monday time on each foot!

drills.name: Sprint Race
steps: Line up at the start.
Pump arms cheek to cheek.
Race to the finish!
drills.fun: Dad starts sitting so the race is fair!
drills.level_up: Win 2 races in a row!

drills.name: Castle Knockdown
steps: Point your glove at the castle.
Step toward the bottles.
Throw and knock them down!
drills.fun: Build the tallest cup castle you can!
drills.level_up: Knock down the whole castle in 3 throws!

drills.name: Catch Ladder
steps: Eyes on the ball.
Catch it soft.
Every catch = take one step back!
drills.fun: How far back can you get?
drills.level_up: Get 3 steps farther than Monday!

drills.name: Dribble Gates
steps: Set up little cone gates.
Soft touches with your feet.
Dribble through as many as you can in 45 seconds!
drills.fun: Count your gates out loud!
drills.level_up: Beat your gate record!

drills.name: Flag Pull Challenge
steps: Dad wears lots of flags.
Eyes on the belt.
Grab and rip as many as you can in 30 seconds!
drills.fun: You are the Flag Collector!
drills.level_up: Pull 4 flags before time is up!

drills.name: Rest & Recover
steps: No practice today.
Play outside for fun if you want.
Drink water and stretch if you feel sore.
Get ready for next week!
drills.fun: Goonies rest so they can never say die tomorrow!
drills.level_up: Tell Dad your favorite drill from this week.

weeks.title: Coaching Plan: "Same Skills, One Step Further"

drills.name: Timber Starts
steps: Stand tall like a tree, arms ready.
Lean forward from your ankles — don't bend!
When you tip — TIMBER! — explode into a sprint!
Sprint about 10 big steps, then walk back.
drills.fun: Dad is the lumberjack. Fake-outs like "Tim… BURRITO!" then real "TIMBER!"
drills.level_up: Beat your best Timber time!

videos.title: Top 10 Sprint Acceleration Drills [#10 Falling Sprint]

drills.name: Belly-Button Throws
steps: Stand sideways and point your glove at the target.
Step toward the target.
Turn your belly button to face the target — then throw!
Finish with your hand in your other pocket.
drills.fun: Distance levels like a video game! Hit the target to unlock the next level.
drills.level_up: Reach Level 3 (one giant step farther)!

videos.title: How To Teach 6-8 Year Olds To Catch A Baseball

drills.name: Turnaround Races
steps: Sprint to the cone on "Timber!"
Near the cone: tiny chop steps.
Touch the cone, turn, and sprint back!
Chop, touch, GO!
drills.fun: Sports announcer voice! Loser picks the next silly rule.
drills.level_up: Beat Dad (he has to hop)!

drills.name: Melting Snowman
steps: Stand tall like a snowman. Big snow breaths.
The sun comes out — melt slowly to the ground.
Hug your knees and rock.
Show Dad today's throwing word with no ball!
drills.fun: Sizzle… drip… melt! Slowest melt wins.
drills.level_up: Melt for a full 10-count without rushing!

days.name: Locked Ankles, Both Feet, First Shots

drills.name: Skip & Hop Trail
steps: Skip along the cone trail — step-hop, step-hop!
At the end, hop and stick a ninja landing.
Quiet feet wake fewer giants!
Go again a little faster.
drills.fun: Dad is the sleeping giant. Loud landings wake him up!
drills.level_up: Skip the whole trail with whisper-quiet landings!

videos.title: Teaching Kids How to Skip

drills.name: Gate Passing
drills.time: 10 min, split with the 5yo block below
steps: Lock your ankle (firm foot).
Pass the ball through the cone gate to Dad.
Use the inside of your foot.
Every pass through the gate = a point!
drills.fun: Shrink the gate after every 5 points — boss level!
drills.level_up: Get 5 gate passes in a row!

videos.title: How to Pass A Soccer Ball
#4. How to teach: Passing › Inside foot | Soccer skills in PE (grade K-6)

drills.name: Soccer Bowling + Bonus Shot
steps: Lock your ankle and pass at the bottle pins.
Knock pins down for points!
Bonus: take a shot on goal after!
Reset and go again.
drills.fun: Dad is a terrible goalie who dives too late!
drills.level_up: Knock down all the pins in one turn!

drills.name: Ball Roll Stretch
steps: Sit with legs out, ball on your shins.
Slow-roll the ball toward your toes.
Roll it back up.
Breathe slow — sleepy soccer legs.
drills.fun: Whoever rolls slowest without stopping wins!
drills.level_up: Do 5 super-slow rolls without the ball falling off.

drills.name: Kid's Choice Play
steps: Pick a favorite game from this week.
No new lessons — just play!
Invite Dad to play too.
Stop while it is still fun.
drills.fun: You are the coach today. You pick the game!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad a new rule for your game.

days.name: Moving to the Ball & Full Swing

drills.name: Mirror Shuffle
steps: Face Dad in a wide ready stance.
Shuffle the same way Dad shuffles — you're a mirror!
Stay low and wide.
Don't lose your mirror partner!
drills.fun: Copycat mode! Mirror for 20 seconds to become the leader.
drills.level_up: Lead the mirror for a whole round!

drills.name: Shuffle & Snag
steps: Ready position — feet first!
Shuffle to the ball (don't reach only).
Snag it in your glove.
Toss it back and go again.
drills.fun: Call "FEET!" before every toss.
drills.level_up: Snag 5 balls in a row after shuffling!

videos.title: How To Teach 6-8 Year Olds To Catch A Baseball

drills.name: Rock-Step-Squish swing + soft front toss
steps: Rock: load your hands and weight back.
Step: front foot toward the ball.
Squish the bug and swing!
Soft toss from Dad — eyes on it.
drills.fun: Say "Rock, Step, Squish" out loud each swing!
drills.level_up: Hit 3 fair balls in a row!

videos.title: How to Soft Toss | YOUTH BASEBALL AND SOFTBALL

drills.name: Zone Derby
steps: Hit the ball into scoring zones.
Close = 1, middle = 2, far = 3!
Use Rock-Step-Squish on every swing.
Add up your points!
drills.fun: Home-run trot + crowd noise for any 3-point hit!
drills.level_up: Score 8 points in one round!

drills.name: Glove Pillow
steps: Lie down with your glove as a pillow.
Slow breaths — in and out.
Think of your best catch today.
Tell Dad one thing you did awesome.
drills.fun: Glove pillow fort. Cozy champion vibes.
drills.level_up: Stay quiet and still for 5 whole breaths.

drills.name: Freeze Cuts
steps: Jog around the yard.
On the call, plant your outside foot!
Cut hard the other way.
Freeze like a statue when music stops!
drills.fun: Freeze-dance cuts to music!
drills.level_up: Make 5 sharp cuts without falling.

drills.name: Route Cards + Laces Grip
steps: Huddle up and call a route.
Run your five steps and cut.
Catch it and race to the end zone!
Touchdown dance!
drills.fun: Real huddles, team name, and a dance every score!
drills.level_up: Score 2 touchdowns!

videos.title: How to Catch a Football | NFL FLAG Drills
How to hold a football the RIGHT way

drills.name: Route Call Touchdown
steps: Huddle up and call a route.
Run your five steps and cut.
Catch it and race to the end zone!
Touchdown dance!
drills.fun: Real huddles, team name, and a dance every score!
drills.level_up: Score 2 touchdowns!

drills.name: Playbook Draw
steps: Sit, sip water, 3 slow breaths.
Draw your favorite play in the dirt or on paper.
Walk through it slow with Dad.
Name your play something awesome!
drills.fun: Your playbook gets a cool cover name!
drills.level_up: Teach your play to Dad in under 30 seconds.

days.name: Teach-Back Day & the Triple Threat Course

drills.name: Movement Dice
steps: Roll the dice!
1=skip, 2=hop, 3=shuffle, 4=bear crawl, 5=sprint, 6=Dad does it too!
Do that move across the yard.
Roll again!
drills.fun: A 6 means Dad has to do the goofy move!
drills.level_up: Complete every number 1–6 once!

drills.name: Coach Big Brother
steps: You are the coach today!
Pick one skill and teach it to Dad (or a sibling).
Use the cue word like a real coach.
Watch them try — give a high five!
drills.fun: Whistle + clipboard. Call yourself Coach!
drills.level_up: Teach a full drill without Dad helping.

drills.name: Triple Threat Course
steps: Station 1: throw at a target (say Belly!).
Station 2: dribble through gates (Small Touches!).
Station 3: pull a flag (Grab!).
Race the course — quality over crazy speed!
drills.fun: Podium ceremony! Fastest AND Most Focused awards.
drills.level_up: Finish the course clean with all 3 cues said out loud!

drills.name: Week Wrap Circle
steps: Sit in a circle and stretch.
Say the best thing you did this week.
Say one cue word you love.
Cheer for each other!
drills.fun: Week wrap high-five train!
drills.level_up: Remember 3 different cue words from the week!

drills.name: Rest & Recover
steps: No practice today.
Play outside for fun if you want.
Drink water and stretch if you feel sore.
Get ready for next week!
drills.fun: Goonies rest so they can never say die tomorrow!
drills.level_up: Tell Dad your favorite drill from this week.

weeks.title: Home Training Plan: "Catch It, Then Send It"

drills.name: Popcorn Ready
steps: Jog or skip around the yard.
When Dad claps and yells POPCORN — pop into ready!
Feet wide, knees bent, glove out, eyes up.
Hold 2 seconds, then jog again!
drills.fun: You're corn in a hot pan! Fake claps try to trick you.
drills.level_up: After you pop, shuffle 2 steps the way Dad points!

drills.name: Alligator Grounders
steps: Get in Popcorn ready.
Glove down to the grass — eat the grass!
When the ball rolls in: CHOMP with your top hand!
Pull it to your belly and throw it back.
drills.fun: You're an alligator! Balls are fish. Count fish eaten!
drills.level_up: Chomp 8 fish before any swim past you!

videos.title: Alligator hands

drills.name: Crow Hop Target Throws
steps: Face the target with the ball.
Little scoot-hop — back foot lands sideways.
Front foot steps at the target.
Throw and finish by your opposite pocket!
drills.fun: Hoop = 3 points, fence = 1. Pick: same distance or step back for double points?
drills.level_up: Score 10 points in 5 throws!

videos.title: Youth Baseball Drills: Throw with Crow Hop

drills.name: Grounder Goalie
steps: Stand in the middle of the cone goal.
Dad rolls grounders to score.
Shuffle so your body is in the MIDDLE, then Chomp!
First to 7 wins!
drills.fun: Dad is the evil striker. You are the world's best goalie!
drills.level_up: After a clean chomp, crow-hop throw at the target for bonus!

drills.name: Glove Boat
steps: Lie on your back, glove on your tummy.
Breathe in — the boat floats up.
Breathe out — the boat sinks.
Five sleepy boat breaths.
drills.fun: Quiet lake story while the boats float…
drills.level_up: Keep the glove on for 5 breaths without touching it!

drills.name: Piano Toe Taps
steps: Put the ball under your toes.
Tap tap tap like playing piano!
Keep your head up.
Count your taps — beat your record!
drills.fun: Play music and tap to the beat!
drills.level_up: Beat your tap record by 5!

drills.name: Pillow First Touch
steps: Dad rolls or tosses the ball to you.
Cushion it like a soft pillow — don't let it bounce away!
Guide it toward a little gate.
Then pass it back.
drills.fun: The ball is a wild egg — don't crack it!
drills.level_up: Two gate touches in a row without a crack!

videos.title: Passing Drill for Youth Players: First Touch into Space

drills.name: Shoelace Shots
steps: Plant your non-kicking foot by the ball.
Kick with your shoelaces (top of the foot).
Swing through toward the goal.
Name your shot — Thunder Rocket!
drills.fun: Corner towels = 3 points. Anywhere in = 1.
drills.level_up: Hit a corner for 3 points!

videos.title: Kids soccer SHOOTING basics ⚽️

drills.name: Treasure Keeper
steps: Guard your soccer-ball treasure!
Dad tries to steal it for 10 seconds.
Use your body like a shell — keep him out!
Switch: now YOU are the pirate!
drills.fun: Arrrr! Pirate voices and a loud countdown!
drills.level_up: Protect the treasure for a full 10 seconds!

drills.name: Sleepy Sole Rolls
steps: Put your foot on top of the ball.
Slow-roll it with your sole.
Keep it sleepy-slow — no stopping.
Tuck the ball in when you finish.
drills.fun: The ball is falling asleep. Slowest roller tucks it in best!
drills.level_up: Roll for 20 seconds without the ball escaping.

drills.name: Kid's Choice Play
steps: Pick a favorite game from this week.
No new lessons — just play!
Invite Dad to play too.
Stop while it is still fun.
drills.fun: You are the coach today. You pick the game!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad a new rule for your game.

drills.name: Moonwalk Backpedal
steps: Face Dad and backpedal like a moonwalk!
Stay on your toes, eyes up.
Keep a force-field gap from Dad.
If he taps you — silly dance!
drills.fun: Dad is a robot chasing your force field!
drills.level_up: Backpedal 10 steps without crossing your feet!

drills.name: Window Handoffs
steps: Make a window with your elbow up and hands open.
Dad (QB) places the ball in your window.
Squeeze it tight — hide it!
Burst upfield 5 steps.
drills.fun: 5 clean handoffs = Super Bowl spike!
drills.level_up: Get 5 clean handoffs in a row!

videos.title: The Handoff | Fun Flag Football Drills by MOJO

drills.name: Phone Call Throws
steps: Hold the ball by your ear like a phone.
Step and throw to the basket target.
Follow through — hang up the phone!
Basket = touchdown!
drills.fun: Phone-call celebration: "Hello, Mom? I scored!"
drills.level_up: Score 2 touchdowns (basket catches)!

drills.name: Mr. Wolf Flag Escape
steps: Mr. Wolf (Dad) faces away.
Sneak closer when he says a time!
When he turns — ZIGZAG and escape!
Don't let the wolf pull your flag!
drills.fun: Huge hungry wolf voice. 13 o'clock is allowed!
drills.level_up: Escape without your flag getting pulled!

drills.name: Starfish & Seashell
steps: Lie down and stretch wide like a starfish.
Then curl up small like a seashell.
Slow ocean breaths.
Starfish… seashell… repeat.
drills.fun: Ocean story: waves wash over the starfish…
drills.level_up: Do 5 slow starfish-seashells without rushing.

drills.name: Puppet Skips
steps: Skip tall — strings pulling your knees up!
Swing your arms like a puppet.
When Dad drops the strings — flop!
Pop back up and skip again.
drills.fun: Dad is the puppet master. Flop = comedy gold!
drills.level_up: Skip across the yard with high puppet knees!

drills.name: Whisper Landings
steps: Jump up high!
Land soft like a whisper — bend your knees.
Quiet feet = more points!
Stick the landing like glue.
drills.fun: Dad judges with eyes closed. Silent = 3 points!
drills.level_up: Get two silent landings in a row!

videos.title: Elementary physical education and assessment- jumping and landing

drills.name: Skater Bounds
steps: Hop side to side like a speed skater.
Stick each landing for a second.
Swing your arms for balance.
Smooth gold-medal skates!
drills.fun: Olympic commentary on every clean stick!
drills.level_up: Do 6 skater bounds without a wobble!

drills.name: Pounce
steps: Ready like a cheetah.
When Dad drops or rolls the ball — POUNCE!
Catch or smother it fast.
Reset and hunt again!
drills.fun: You're a cheetah, balls are rabbits. Fridge record chart!
drills.level_up: Pounce 5 rabbits in a row — then step one step farther back!

drills.name: Sloth Crawl Tunnel
steps: Crawl slow like a sloth.
Keep your tummy off the hot lava floor!
Go through Dad's tunnel arms.
Slowest sloth wins.
drills.fun: Sloth noises required. Floor is lava jungle!
drills.level_up: Crawl the tunnel without touching lava.

days.name: Fly Balls, Run-Throughs & the Triple Crown

drills.name: Orbit Ball Wraps
steps: Circle the ball around your waist — orbit!
Then around your knees.
Then around your head (careful!).
Try moon-speed: slow, medium, rocket!
drills.fun: You're a planet, the ball is your moon!
drills.level_up: Two-clap challenge: wrap, clap twice, wrap again!

drills.name: Umbrella Fly Balls
steps: Get under the ball like an umbrella!
Move your feet early.
Catch it above your head when you can.
Eyes on it the whole way.
drills.fun: Rainstorm! Catch every drop Dad tosses!
drills.level_up: Catch 5 raindrops in a row!

videos.title: How to Teach Kids How to Catch Fly Balls

drills.name: Tape Run-Throughs
steps: Sprint toward the tape (finish line).
Run STRAIGHT THROUGH — don't stop early!
Break the tape like an Olympian!
Slow down AFTER the line.
drills.fun: Announcer voice: "...and he BREAKS THE TAPE!"
drills.level_up: Beat your best tape time!

videos.title: Little League Tee Ball Baserunning Drill. Helping tee ball players to run through first base.

drills.name: The Backyard Triple Crown
steps: Event 1: fly-ball catches.
Event 2: run through the tape.
Event 3: throw at a target.
Add your scores — Triple Crown champ!
drills.fun: Championship announcer + paper crown!
drills.level_up: Beat Dad's Number to pick next week's warm-up!

drills.name: Highlight Replay
steps: Pick your best play of the day.
Act it out in slow motion!
Dad announces the replay.
Freeze for the highlight photo!
drills.fun: Announcer: "He's under it… CAUGHT IT!"
drills.level_up: Replay 2 different awesome moments!

drills.name: Rest & Recover
steps: No practice today.
Play outside for fun if you want.
Drink water and stretch if you feel sore.
Get ready for next week!
drills.fun: Goonies rest so they can never say die tomorrow!
drills.level_up: Tell Dad your favorite drill from this week.

weeks.title: Home Training Plan: "Aim It, Fake It, Lead It"

drills.name: Shadow Infield
steps: Copy Dad like a shadow — same moves at the same time!
Shuffle, field an imaginary grounder, hop and throw.
Go slow, then a little faster.
Last rounds: YOU are the leader!
drills.fun: Do it to music. Add a surprise freeze or goofy slow-mo dive!
drills.level_up: Lead 2 whole shadow sequences for Dad to copy.

drills.name: Laser Gate Front Toss
steps: Get in your hitting stance.
Dad soft-tosses the ball to you.
Hit a laser through the cone gate!
Aim up the middle — then try the opposite-field gate.
drills.fun: You are a laser cannon — "pew!" for every gate hit. Chase YOUR best round.
drills.level_up: Hit 3 lasers through the gate in one round!

videos.title: Ripken Baseball Hitting Tip - Basic Front Toss

drills.name: Field-and-Fire to First
steps: Ready for a grounder — Popcorn!
TICK: chomp the ball clean.
TOCK: scoot-hop and throw to first!
Ball in the basket = OUT!
drills.fun: Count outs. Three outs = victory lap around the bases!
drills.level_up: Get 3 outs in a row with a clean tick-tock.

videos.title: Crow Hop + Throwing Progression Drill

drills.name: Beat the Runner
steps: Dad rolls a grounder, then runs to first!
Field it (tick) and throw to first (tock).
Beat the runner for an OUT!
First to 5 wins.
drills.fun: Radio announcer voice and dramatic slides!
drills.level_up: Get 3 outs before Dad scores 3 safes.

drills.name: Pancake Stretch
steps: Sit with legs out. Roll the ball down to your toes.
Butterfly sit — knees drop like pancakes.
Lie flat as a pancake. Three slow breaths.
Tell Dad which gate you hit the most!
drills.fun: What kind of pancake are you today — chocolate chip or home-run?
drills.level_up: Do 5 slow pancake rolls without rushing.

days.name: Fake It, Slice It, Beat the Troll

drills.name: Bumper Car Dribble
steps: Dribble your ball with soft touches.
Keep your head UP — look for traffic!
Steer around Dad the bumper car.
Don't crash your ball into anyone!
drills.fun: Beep beep! Dad breaks down in your path on purpose.
drills.level_up: Dribble 20 seconds heads-up without looking at your feet.

drills.name: The Pretend Shot
steps: Run at Dad with the ball.
Fake a big shot — sell it!
Then take the ball the other way (Trick!).
Escape past him to the gate.
drills.fun: Oscar points for the most dramatic fake. Dad falls for it hilariously!
drills.level_up: Fool Dad with your fake 3 times in a row!

videos.title: 3 Essential Soccer Moves. Fake & Take, Pullbacks & Roll to Hide ⚽

drills.name: Slice-Away Escape
steps: Dribble toward the lava line.
SLICE the ball sideways with the inside of your foot!
Burst through the escape gate.
Keep the ball close the whole time.
drills.fun: The line is lava! Count escapes in a row.
drills.level_up: Slice-escape 4 times without losing the ball.

videos.title: Inside Cut - 1v1 Moves - Change of Direction - Crossing - Soccer (Football) Skills for U8-U9

drills.name: Bridge Troll 1v1
steps: Dad is the troll on the bridge.
Use Trick or Slice to sneak past!
Get your ball across for a point.
Switch: now YOU are the troll!
drills.fun: Big troll voice. Stolen balls get dramatic munching!
drills.level_up: Beat the troll 3 times with a real move (not just speed).

drills.name: Lighthouse Stretch
steps: Stand tall like a lighthouse.
Slowly sweep your arms like a light beam.
Big calm breaths.
Find the lost ship in the fog!
drills.fun: Tiny story: ship lost in fog… sweep the light… there it is!
drills.level_up: Sweep 5 slow full circles without wobbling.

drills.name: Kid's Choice Play
steps: Pick a favorite game from this week.
No new lessons — just play!
Invite Dad to play too.
Stop while it is still fun.
drills.fun: You are the coach today. You pick the game!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad a new rule for your game.

days.name: Lead the Receiver & Break on the Ball

drills.name: Conveyor Belt Catches
steps: Hands ready — reach for the package!
Dad sends soft footballs one after another.
Catch and drop into the bin fast.
Keep the conveyor moving!
drills.fun: You're a factory. Dropped packages make a silly crash noise!
drills.level_up: Deliver 8 packages without a crash.

drills.name: Landing-Zone Lead Passes
steps: You are the QB. Spot the landing hoop AHEAD of the runner.
Throw where they're GOING — not where they are!
Receiver runs to the spot and catches.
Name your play — Rocket Slant!
drills.fun: Hoop catch = touchdown (6). Close = field goal (3).
drills.level_up: Complete 3 lead-pass touchdowns!

videos.title: Passing Drill - Leading the Receiver

drills.name: Ballhawk Breaks
steps: Backpedal like a moonwalk defender.
When Dad throws — BREAK toward the ball!
Knock it down or intercept it!
Pick six: run it back past Dad!
drills.fun: You're a ballhawk! Interception = 2, knockdown = 1.
drills.level_up: Get 2 interceptions in one round!

videos.title: Backfoot Breaks

drills.name: Pick-Six Showdown
steps: One player throws lead passes.
The other tries to break and pick it!
Interception = pick-six celebration!
Keep score on the driveway.
drills.fun: Play-by-play commentary and celebration dances!
drills.level_up: Score a pick-six and a touchdown throw in the same game!

drills.name: Goalpost Stretch
steps: Arms up like football goalposts.
Hold still and breathe.
Dad tosses a soft ball through your uprights!
Field goal — good!
drills.fun: Last field goal through your arm uprights!
drills.level_up: Hold goalposts steady for 3 slow breaths.

drills.name: Pogo Stick Bounces
steps: Bounce in place on two feet like a pogo stick!
Soft whisper landings.
Try tiny forward pogos.
Pogo party for 5 seconds!
drills.fun: Pogo to the beat of a song!
drills.level_up: Pogo 15 times in a row without stopping.

drills.name: Hopscotch Hustle
steps: Jump the hopscotch pattern — spring off the ground!
One foot / two feet like the squares say.
Don't touch the lines.
Toss the beanbag and play a full round!
drills.fun: Time a clean trip and try to beat it!
drills.level_up: Finish a clean hopscotch with no line touches!

videos.title: How to Play Hopscotch - Equipment Free PE and Recess Games

drills.name: Wake-Up Starts
steps: Start lying down, sitting, or facing backward.
When Dad says BLASTOFF — pop up and sprint!
Ignore silly trick words.
Different start each round.
drills.fun: Rocket countdown… then surprise blastoff words!
drills.level_up: Win 3 blastoff races from different starts!

videos.title: Quick Start

drills.name: Wake-Up Bacon Snatch
steps: Wait in your wake-up pose.
On BACON — snatch the flag/sock and race!
Fake words like Eggs or Pancakes — don't go!
First to grab wins the bacon.
drills.fun: Sizzle sounds while you wait. Fake food words!
drills.level_up: Grab the bacon 3 times without falling for a fake.

drills.name: Snow Angel Breaths
steps: Lie down and make slow snow angels.
Big breaths — in and out.
Feel imaginary snowflakes on your nose.
Tell Dad your favorite start pose today.
drills.fun: Pretend it's snowing. Narrate snowflakes!
drills.level_up: Make 5 slow angels with matching breaths.

drills.name: Monster Mash Moves
steps: March like a stompy monster!
Then skip, shuffle, or bear-crawl monster style.
Monster sounds required!
Invent a new monster for the last trip.
drills.fun: Each boy invents a new monster move!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad your invented monster walk.

drills.name: Pumpkin Patch Spray Hitting
steps: Hit toward different pumpkin targets!
Call your pumpkin before you swing.
Spray the ball — not always the same way.
Wake up a haunted pumpkin!
drills.fun: Spooky sound effects when a pumpkin wakes up!
drills.level_up: Hit 3 different pumpkins in one round!

videos.title: Top 5 Ways to Teaching Hitting to the Opposite Field

drills.name: Ghost Defender Finishing
steps: Dribble at the ghost defender (Dad/cone).
Fake or slice past — BOO!
Finish with a shoelace shot on goal.
Goal = treats!
drills.fun: Ghost voice: "You can't get past meeee..."
drills.level_up: Beat the ghost and score 2 goals!

drills.name: Haunted House Gauntlet
steps: Run the haunted stations in order!
Hitting… soccer finish… flag escape…
Collect treats for clean stations.
Beat the Monster's Number!
drills.fun: Halloween decorations + spooky music. Keep the candy if you win!
drills.level_up: Beat the Monster's Number to pick a reward!

drills.name: Jack-o'-Lantern Candle
steps: Sit calm like a jack-o'-lantern.
Hold up one finger candle.
Blow it out with a slow breath — tssss!
Tell Dad your favorite haunted station.
drills.fun: Pinch out each candle with a "tssss" sound.
drills.level_up: Blow out 5 candles with super-slow breaths.

drills.name: Rest & Recover
steps: No practice today.
Play outside for fun if you want.
Drink water and stretch if you feel sore.
Get ready for next week!
drills.fun: Goonies rest so they can never say die tomorrow!
drills.level_up: Tell Dad your favorite drill from this week.

weeks.title: Home Training Plan: "Partner Up: Catch It, Pass It, Cut It Off"

drills.name: Find the Bag
steps: Start at your cone, ready like popcorn.
Dad yells GROUNDER and points away from you.
Sprint to first: throwing foot on the front of the bag!
Chest at the thrower, glove up big.
drills.fun: Radio voice: "The first baseman is THERE!" Beat your best time.
drills.level_up: Get to the bag and set up perfectly 5 times in a row.

videos.title: Youth Baseball 1st Base Footwork and Drills

drills.name: Stretch & Squeeze at First
steps: Foot on the bag, glove up.
Wait until the ball is in the air...
STRETCH: step and reach your glove to the ball!
Squeeze it with two hands. Back foot stays on the bag.
drills.fun: Every catch on the bag = a big umpire OUT call!
drills.level_up: Catch 10 outs in a row with your foot on the bag.

drills.name: Glove-Down Tags
steps: Stand BESIDE the base, not on it.
Catch the ball and squeeze it in your glove.
Put your glove down on the doorstep, in front of the base.
Let the runner slide into it. OUT!
drills.fun: Dad is a sneaky runner with silly names!
drills.level_up: Make 5 tags in a row with your glove on the doorstep.

videos.title: How to Properly Tag a Baserunner // 3 Simple Steps for Youth Players to Get 100% Outs!

drills.name: Bang-Bang at First
steps: Dad rolls a grounder and runs to first.
Fielder: tick-tock throw to first!
First baseman: bag, stretch, catch!
Beat Dad = OUT! Bang-bang!
drills.fun: Brothers vs. Dad! Stadium noise on every close play.
drills.level_up: Get 7 outs before Dad gets 7 safes.

drills.name: Bear Hug Stretch
steps: Give yourself a giant bear hug.
Hold it for 3 slow breaths.
Hug one knee, then the other.
Tell Dad when it's time to stretch for the throw.
drills.fun: Finish with a real family bear hug and a growl!
drills.level_up: Hold each hug for 3 slow breaths without rushing.

days.name: One-Two, Magnet & Two Against the Giant

drills.name: Postman Pass-and-Move
steps: Dad passes you the letter (the ball).
Pass it back with the side of your foot.
MOVE to a new empty house!
Call "Here!" when you get there.
drills.fun: Dad is a cranky postman. Nobody home? He eats the letter!
drills.level_up: Make 10 perfect deliveries in a row.

drills.name: Bounce-Back One-Two
steps: Dribble toward the cone defender.
Pass to Dad: ONE!
Run past the other side of the cone.
Get the ball back: TWO! Then score.
drills.fun: You're a pinball bouncing off the bumper! Pinball sounds!
drills.level_up: Score 3 goals with a one-two.

videos.title: Coaching Soccer ~ How to do a Wall Pass + Online Soccer Academy

drills.name: 2v1 Magnet
steps: Dribble straight at the giant like a magnet.
Giant comes to you? Pass to your buddy!
Giant stays with your buddy? Keep going and shoot!
Watch what the giant does.
drills.fun: The giant gets dizzy and falls over after a great pass!
drills.level_up: Make the right choice 4 times in a row.

videos.title: CATZCoach: 2v1

drills.name: Two Against the Giant
steps: You and your brother are a team.
Pass to your buddy to beat the giant.
Goal after a pass = 2 points!
Goal after a one-two = 3 points!
drills.fun: Fee-fi-fo-fum! The giant snores after every goal.
drills.level_up: Score a 3-point one-two goal against the giant!

drills.name: Seesaw Stretch
steps: Sit facing your brother, feet touching.
Hold hands.
Slowly lean back and forth like a seesaw.
Tell Dad what you did when the giant came to you.
drills.fun: Sing Row, Row, Row Your Boat slowly!
drills.level_up: Do 6 slow seesaws without a wobble.

drills.name: Kid's Choice Play
steps: Pick a favorite game from this week.
No new lessons — just play!
Invite Dad to play too.
Stop while it is still fun.
drills.fun: You are the coach today. You pick the game!
drills.level_up: Teach Dad a new rule for your game.

days.name: QB on the Move & Cut-Off Angles

drills.name: Sidewinder Shuffle Toss
steps: Face Dad and shuffle sideways like a snake.
Keep your feet moving!
Toss and catch while you shuffle.
Switch directions at the end.
drills.fun: Hiss like a snake on every catch!
drills.level_up: Make 6 catches in one trip without stopping.

drills.name: Rollout Rocket Throws
steps: On HUT, roll out to the side with the ball up high.
Turn your chest to the catcher: SQUARE!
Throw to the hoop ahead of the receiver.
Stay behind the line!
drills.fun: Name your play, like Rocket Rollout! Hoop catch = touchdown.
drills.level_up: Throw 3 touchdowns while you're moving.

videos.title: NFL FLAG Football Quarterback (QB) Position

drills.name: Cut-Off Corner
steps: Dad runs to the finish cone.
Don't chase him!
Run to the meeting spot where your paths cross.
MEET him there and grab the flag!
drills.fun: Dad is a runaway train. Close the gate before the train gets by!
drills.level_up: Pull Dad's flag at the meeting spot 3 times in a row.

videos.title: Youth Flag Football Drill | Defense Pursuit Drill | Cut off the runner | Where they are going | flag

drills.name: Scramble Showdown
steps: QB: the rusher counts three Mississippi...
SCRAMBLE out and throw to Dad!
Rusher: turn into a defender after the catch.
Run to the meeting spot and grab the flag!
drills.fun: Play-by-play announcer: "He's scrambling... he FIRES!"
drills.level_up: Throw a touchdown AND pull a flag in the same game.

drills.name: Kneel-Down Stretch
steps: Take a knee like a QB who just won the game.
Slowly push your hips forward.
Hold for 3 breaths, then switch knees.
Tell Dad: did you run to where he was or where he was going?
drills.fun: The game's over, we won! Whisper-cheer like a crowd.
drills.level_up: Hold each side for 3 slow breaths.

days.name: Hot Feet, Rope Rookies & Dribble Traffic

drills.name: Dribble Traffic Cop
steps: Push the ball down with your fingertips.
GREEN: walk and dribble!
YELLOW: dribble in place.
RED: catch it and hold it tight!
drills.fun: Car horns, sirens, and a flashing yellow for super-low dribbles!
drills.level_up: Dribble 20 times in a row with your weaker hand.

videos.title: Basketball Dribbling Drills For 6-9 Year Olds

drills.name: Chalk Ladder Lightning
steps: One foot in every box, quick and light!
Then two feet in every box.
Try sideways: in-in-out-out!
No touching the lines.
drills.fun: The lines are lava cracks! Invent a pattern for Dad to try.
drills.level_up: Do a clean in-in-out-out trip and beat your best time.

drills.name: Rope Rookie Jumps
steps: Rope behind your heels.
Swing it over your head.
When it lands in front of your toes, HOP!
Swing-hop, swing-hop. Keep going!
drills.fun: Keep a streak board in chalk. Try a jump rope rhyme!
drills.level_up: Jump 10 in a row without stopping.

videos.title: How to Teach a Kid to Jump Rope for the First Time | Kindergarten PE Lesson |

drills.name: Snake & Helicopter
steps: Dad wiggles the rope like a snake.
Jump over it without getting bitten!
Helicopter: jump when the rope spins by.
You and your brother are a team vs. the snake.
drills.fun: Name the snake! Big hissing sounds.
drills.level_up: Jump the helicopter rope 10 times in a row.

drills.name: Sunset Stretch
steps: Reach your arms up high like the sun.
Lower them slowly like a sunset.
Sit and reach for your toes.
Tell Dad: ladder or rope, which was harder?
drills.fun: Try it outside when the real sun is going down!
drills.level_up: Do 4 super-slow sunsets.

drills.name: Four-Corner Sport Switch
steps: Each corner is a sport.
Run there and do that sport's move!
SWITCH: change direction to a new corner.
Last call: sprint!
drills.fun: Silly switches: run there like a penguin!
drills.level_up: Call the corners yourself for one round.

drills.name: Dance-with-the-Pitcher Gate Hitting
steps: Get in your stance and watch Dad's arm.
Arm goes back: you load. Arm comes forward: you step.
DANCE together, then swing!
Hit it through the middle gate.
drills.fun: Dance to music between rounds!
drills.level_up: Hit 3 balls through the gate in one round.

drills.name: Pass-and-Pivot Partners
steps: Chest pass: push it, thumbs down!
Bounce pass: hit the X on the ground.
Catch it and jump stop on both feet.
GLUE one foot down and pivot, then pass back.
drills.fun: Play keep-away from Dad the monkey with pivots and bounce passes!
drills.level_up: Make 10 passes in a row without a drop.

videos.title: The Two-Handed Pass: Chest and Bounce | Basketball

drills.name: One-Eyed Willy's Treasure Trail
steps: Follow the treasure map through 5 stations.
Ladder, first base, one-two, rollout, pivot pass!
Clean station = 1 gold coin.
Fill the treasure chest as a team!
drills.fun: Pirate voices! Goonies never say die when you miss and try again.
drills.level_up: Beat One-Eyed Willy's number to win the prize!

drills.name: Drop Anchor Breathing
steps: Sit and put your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly: the anchor goes up.
Breathe out slowly: the anchor goes down.
Tell Dad your favorite play of the week.
drills.fun: Hands in: "Goonies never say die!"
drills.level_up: Do 5 slow anchor breaths.

drills.name: Rest & Recover
steps: No practice today.
Play outside for fun if you want.
Drink water and stretch if you feel sore.
Get ready for next week!
drills.fun: Goonies rest so they can never say die tomorrow!
drills.level_up: Tell Dad your favorite drill from this week.
